# zerops_object_storage (Resource)

Owns an object-storage bucket service. Deletion destroys bucket data. Quota can grow or shrink subject to server usage constraints. Custom policies support native website JSON, not arbitrary AWS policy semantics. CDN enable may fail in some regions; asynchronous failures are surfaced and the bucket is retained.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Native website JSON round-trips through the API; arbitrary AWS policy fields do not.
# Destroying this resource destroys the bucket data.
resource "zerops_object_storage" "example" {
  project_id = zerops_project.example.id
  hostname   = "assets"
  quota_gb   = 10
  policy     = "custom"
  # CDN enable is asynchronous and may fail in some regions. A failure retains
  # the bucket identity and reports the actual remote flag, never false success.
  cdn_enabled = false
  raw_policy = jsonencode({
    websiteAccess = true
    indexDocument = "index.html"
    errorDocument = "404.html"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Service hostname; distinct from generated bucket name.
- `project_id` (String) Parent project ID.
- `quota_gb` (Number) Allocated quota in GB, from 1 to 100; supports grow and shrink.

### Optional

- `cdn_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the storage CDN through its dedicated asynchronous operation. Defaults to false. Backend enable failures are errors, not availability guarantees.
- `policy` (String) Policy: private (default), public-read, public-objects-read, public-write, public-read-write, or custom. Custom is inferred when raw_policy is supplied.
- `raw_policy` (String) Custom policy JSON object, compared semantically. Native websiteAccess/indexDocument/errorDocument round-trip through the API; discarded fields produce an error.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) Generated access key ID.
- `api_url` (String) Object-storage API URL.
- `bucket_name` (String) Generated bucket name.
- `id` (String) Storage service ID.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Generated secret access key, null when masked and not recoverable.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import zerops_object_storage.example "<storage_service_id>"
```
